response.sql:
WITH circuit_averages AS (
    SELECT
        r.circuitId,
        c.country,
        AVG(r.round) AS avg_round
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(avg_round) AS avg_round
    FROM circuit_averages
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
    ca.circuitId,
    ca.country,
    ca.avg_round AS circuit_avg_round,
    ca.avg_round - co.avg_round AS difference
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS co ON co.country = ca.country
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The country's average round is the unweighted average of its circuits' average round numbers, so each circuit contributes equally.

alternatives.interpretation: Average all race rounds in the country together, weighting circuits by how many races they hosted.
